title: OneNote for Android: multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a capture-specific mobile Cloud Policy setting, contrary to the briefing's central governance gap. Microsoft also states that captured audio is deleted after transcription and publishes capture eligibility requirements, so the storage statement and open questions need correction.

claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
